entry.title: Sukharev Tower — museum exterior, 1930
entry.note: The published 1904 Moscow City Council cadastral plan (heritage report PDF page 231, illustration 13) shows the original tower base and eastern staircase. Four surviving Sheremetev Hospital wing corners register this plan to mapped WGS84 coordinates; a least-squares affine registration gives the anchor and directed long axis. Native +X follows the eastern stairs and +Z faces Sretenska to the south-southwest. This is an archival reconstruction frame, not a present-day building footprint. Historical-map registration accuracy is recorded in map-frame.json. Present-day roads and surrounding buildings do not constitute a reconstructed 1930 streetscape. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.

review: Placement uses the signed historical tower frame with approximately 7 m registration uncertainty. In the Earth viewer the reconstruction appears on 1926-01-06 and in 1930, is absent on 1926-01-05 and 1934-04-01, and is absent in undated and current views. The current map supplies terrain and context. Modern roads and their signals are visible beside and through the historic ground-floor arcades. Present-day ground samples at the corners differ from the historical pavement plane by up to 1.87 m. The date-qualified placement depicts the tower’s 1930 exterior over a modern basemap.
